mapper.select: SELECT opportunity.opportunity_id, opportunity.tenant_id, opportunity.customer_id, opportunity.stage, opportunity.status, opportunity.version, customer.dept_id AS scope_dept_id, customer.owner_id AS scope_owner_id FROM crm_opportunity opportunity JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.customer_id = opportunity.customer_id AND customer.tenant_id = opportunity.tenant_id AND customer.deleted = 0 WHERE opportunity.opportunity_id = #{id} AND opportunity.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND opportunity.deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT opportunity.opportunity_id, opportunity.tenant_id, opportunity.customer_id, opportunity.stage, opportunity.status, opportunity.version FROM crm_quote quote JOIN crm_opportunity opportunity ON opportunity.opportunity_id = quote.opportunity_id AND opportunity.tenant_id = quote.tenant_id AND opportunity.customer_id = quote.customer_id AND opportunity.deleted = 0 WHERE quote.quote_id = #{id} AND quote.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND quote.deleted = 0

SELECT quote.quote_id, quote.tenant_id, quote.customer_id, customer.customer_name, quote.owner_id, quote.currency, quote.version, customer.dept_id AS scope_dept_id, customer.owner_id AS scope_owner_id FROM crm_quote quote JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.customer_id = quote.customer_id AND customer.tenant_id = quote.tenant_id AND customer.deleted = 0 WHERE quote.quote_id = #{id} AND quote.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND quote.deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM crm_deal_team WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND biz_type = 'QUOTE' AND biz_id = #{id} AND current_flag = 1 FOR UPDATE
